subject: post-verify lab smoke: a fixed 20s config budget, spent at the one moment the CDN is guaranteed cold
description:
Observed 2026-09-03 on a real deploy: post-verify reported 9 PASS / 1 FAIL, 'CONFIG-GLOBAL PISL09Config never attached within 20000ms'. Re-run minutes later: 10 PASS / 0 FAIL. Not a regression, and nothing in that deploy touched any PIS file. MECHANISM, measured not guessed: (1) pis-l09 is the FIRST lab the smoke visits, so it absorbs browser cold-start; (2) its page loads 11 external scripts with ZERO defer/async, so they execute serially; (3) config.js, which defines PISL09Config, is the 10th of those 11; (4) ~443KB across 10 serial blocking scripts must download AND execute before the global exists; (5) CONFIG_TIMEOUT is a fixed 20000ms (_tools/smoke-lab-content-leaks.js:34); (6) the gate runs immediately after firebase deploy, so every one of those assets is a guaranteed cold CDN miss. Warm, config.js fetches in 0.33s; cold, ten serial origin round trips can approach or exceed the budget. TWO PROBLEMS, not one. (a) The deadline is fixed and is spent at the single worst moment in the deploy lifecycle. (b) The failure message conflates SLOW with BROKEN: 'never attached' reads as a missing or broken config, which is a regression, when the real cause was an unfinished load. The gate cannot distinguish them, so a human must, every time. Note the script already handles this at the NAVIGATION stage (navNote, a 'load (slow)' result at :187) but not at the config stage. SAME CLASS as taskboard 336 (gate 3.7), though not the same fix: 336 slept against a timer and the fix was to observe a state transition; this one ALREADY observes a transition, so the fix is about the budget and about separating slow from broken. Options: warm the assets before timing, retry once on timeout and report 'load (slow)' rather than FAIL, scale the budget by asset count, or check config.js fetched successfully to tell slow from broken. WHY IT MATTERS: a gate that cries wolf trains people to skip it, and this one guards answer-key leaks.
[2026-09-04 02:01] FIXED in 87b2a0b00. Root cause measured: pis-l09 is first visited (absorbs cold-start), 11 blocking scripts with no defer/async, config.js is 10th, ~443KB serial before the global exists, fixed 20s budget spent immediately after firebase deploy when every asset is a guaranteed cold CDN miss. Fix distinguishes BROKEN (same-origin request failed -> fail on first attempt, naming it) from SLOW (everything fetched, chain unfinished -> one retry, reported as 'load (slow)'), and a genuinely absent config still fails after the retry. Also implemented the retry the file's doctrine block described but never had. Three fixtures in _tools/eduscan/smoke/lab-smoke-slow-vs-broken.selftest.js, 3/3, plus 10 PASS/0 FAIL live.
